in_sanskrit.name: Nitheesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Consciousness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nitheesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nitheesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nithi' which means consciousness. This name is given to a boy who is believed to be the embodiment of consciousness and awareness. It is a powerful name that signifies wisdom, enlightenment, and the power to overcome obstacles.
